source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of d orbital splitting (PDF 26).

blocks.text: Paanch d orbitals dxy, dxz, dyz, dx2-y2 aur dz2 hain. Chaar ki shakal teen patti (aik plane mein chaar lobes) aur dz2 ke do lobes aur aik challa hai. Akele atom mein paanchon ki tawanai barabar hai: yeh degenerate hain. In ki shakalein aur simtein transition metals ki bonding, rang aur magnetic khasiyatein tay karti hain.

blocks.alt: Dashed axes wale teen panel. d_xy: x aur y axes ke darmiyan chaar lobes. d_x2-y2: x aur y axes ke saath chaar lobes. d_z2: z axis ke saath do lobes aur beech mein xy plane mein aik challa (ring). Do rang ulte phases dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Teen 3d orbitals ki shakalein (3dxy aur 3dz2 orbitals wale learning outcome ke liye asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Paanch 3d orbitals hain. In mein se chaar (dxy, dxz, dyz aur dx2-y2) ke aik plane mein chaar lobes hain, teen patti (cloverleaf) jaisi shakal: dxy, dxz aur dyz axes ke darmiyan, jab ke dx2-y2 x aur y axes ke saath hai. Paanchwan, dz2, z axis ke saath do lobes aur beech mein electron density ka challa (doughnut) rakhta hai. Kyunke orbitals mukhtalif simton mein hain, axes ke saath aane wale ligands un par mukhtalif asar karte hain.

blocks.title: Degenerate aur non-degenerate orbitals
blocks.text: Degenerate orbitals ki tawanai barabar hoti hai. Jab ligands complex banane ke liye dhaat ke ion ke qareeb aate hain to un ka electric field paanch d orbitals ko mukhtalif tawanai ke do sets mein baant deta hai (non-degenerate). Dono sets ka tawanai ka farq delta E likha jata hai.
Octahedral complex (chhe ligands), jaise [Ti(H2O)6]3+, mein d orbitals teen kam tawanai wale (dxy, dxz, dyz) aur do zyada tawanai wale (dx2-y2, dz2) orbitals mein bat jate hain.

blocks.alt: Tawanai ka khaaka. Baen: azad ion ke paanch barabar (degenerate) d dabbe, aik mein electron. Beech mein: complex mein dabbe teen neeche (dxy, dxz, dyz) aur do oopar (dx2-y2, dz2) mein bat jate, darmiyan delta E; electron neeche ke dabbe mein. delta E = h nu tawanai ki roshni use oopar ke dabbe mein le jati hai (daen).
blocks.caption: Octahedral field mein d orbitals ki splitting (Figure 18.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: [Ti(H2O)6]3+ jaise octahedral complex mein chhe ligands x, y aur z axes ke saath aate hain. dx2-y2 aur dz2 orbitals seedhe un ki taraf hain aur tawanai mein oopar jate hain; dxy, dxz aur dyz un ke darmiyan hain aur neeche aate hain. Dono set ka farq delta E hai. Ti3+ ka aik 3d electron hai; delta E tawanai ki roshni jazb kar ke woh neeche se oopar ke orbital mein chala jata hai.

blocks.text: Tetrahedral complex (chaar ligands), jaise [CuCl4]2-, mein splitting ulat jati hai: teen zyada tawanai wale (dxy, dxz, dyz) aur do kam tawanai wale (dx2-y2, dz2) orbitals. Splitting octahedral complexes se kam hoti hai.

blocks.alt: [CuCl4]2- (d9) ka tawanai khaaka. Nau electrons wale paanch degenerate dabbe do neeche (dx2-y2, dz2), dono bhare, aur teen oopar (dxy, dxz, dyz) jin mein paanch electrons, mein bat jate hain, chhote farq delta E ke saath. Roshni jazb karne se aik electron neeche se oopar jata hai.
blocks.caption: Tetrahedral field mein d orbitals ki splitting (Figure 18.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Tetrahedral complex mein chaar ligands axes par nahi hote, is liye splitting ulat jati hai: dxy, dxz aur dyz oopar aur dx2-y2 aur dz2 neeche jate hain. Sirf chaar ligands, jin mein koi kisi orbital ki seedh mein nahi, ki wajah se splitting octahedral complex se kam hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Octahedral complex mein kaun se d orbitals zyada tawanai par hain, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: dx2-y2 aur dz2, kyunke un ke lobes axes par maujood ligands ki seedh mein hain aur sab se zyada dhakelay jate hain.

items: Azad ion mein paanch d orbitals degenerate; ligands unhein delta E se baant'te.
Octahedral: 3 neeche, 2 oopar. Tetrahedral: 2 neeche, 3 oopar, chhota farq.
